slides.say: Use effect and use layout effect take the same arguments. The difference is when they run.

slides.text: useLayoutEffect: after the DOM update, BEFORE paint. It blocks the paint.
slides.say: Use layout effect runs after the DOM updates and before the browser repaints. The paint waits for it.

slides.text: useEffect: usually AFTER paint. Doesn’t block the browser.
slides.say: Use effect usually runs after the screen is painted, so it does not block the browser.

slides.text: Visual glitch you must hide? Layout effect. Everything else? useEffect.
slides.say: If you must read layout and fix it before anyone sees it, use layout effect. For everything else, use effect.
